title: lazycmd command spec
description:
The one command spec shape shared by a project's commands.yaml and a <script>.lazycmd.yaml sidecar. Keep in sync with internal/config/spec.go. Reference from a YAML file with:
  # yaml-language-server: $schema=../schema/lazycmd-commands.schema.json

default.description: A plain YAML scalar (quoting is optional even for a bool param's default).

pattern.description: A regexp a string param's value must match.

options.description: Static choices for a select/multi param.

options_cmd.description: Shell command whose stdout lines become a select/multi param's choices. Runs in the project root with the other answered params as LC_<NAME> env vars.

depends_on.description: Names of earlier params that, when changed, cause options_cmd to re-run.

run.description: Inline shell. Exactly one of run/script, on a commands.yaml entry.

script.description: Path to a script, relative to the project root. Exactly one of run/script.

args.description: Arguments for the script, one per entry. {param} is replaced by that param's value ({{ and }} are literal braces); a value with spaces or ; is still one argument, since no shell is involved. An entry whose placeholders are all empty is dropped, so "--env={env}" vanishes when env is empty. Needs a script (or, in a sidecar, the script beside it); not allowed with run:. Params are also still passed as LC_<NAME> env vars.

oneOf.description: a sidecar file: the same command shape, without the commands: wrapper
